lead_independence.lead: A person died after being shot Wednesday night at a residence in the Seminole Mobile Home Park community in the 3300 block of Orange Avenue, according to the St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office. Deputies with the Sheriff's Office Patrol Operations Bureau and personnel from the St. Lucie County Fire District responded at approximately 9:11 p.m. following reports of a shooting. The initial caller reported that an individual had been shot while allegedly attempting to enter a residence.
